definitions.explanation: The entire school, meaning every student (and often the staff) of a single school taken together.

examples.english: The whole school sang a song.

examples.japanese: {全校集会|ぜんこうしゅうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A whole-school assembly was held in the gymnasium.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全校|ぜんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Every student in the school took part in this initiative.

notes:
Prefix ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (whole, all) + {校|こう} (school). Usually used attributively before another noun rather than standing alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全校集会|ぜんこうしゅうかい}: a whole-school assembly
- {全校生徒|ぜんこうせいと}: all the students of the school
- {全校朝会|ぜんこうちょうかい}: a whole-school morning meeting
